title: cargo-crap absolute report (v1)
description: Wire format produced by `cargo crap --format json` (without `--baseline`).

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema this document conforms to.

version.description: cargo-crap crate version that produced this report.

entries.description: Per-function CRAP entries, sorted by score descending.

diagnostics.description: Optional source/LCOV scope diagnostics (spec 24); absent for complexity-only runs.

duplicates.description: Candidate duplicate function pairs, ordered by descending score. Present only on `--duplicates` runs; absent (not empty) otherwise, so "not asked" stays distinguishable from "asked, found nothing".

try_weight.description: The weight each `?` operator added to cyclomatic complexity when the entries were scored (`try-weight` in `.cargo-crap.toml`). Present only when it is not the default 1.0; absent means 1.0.

DuplicatePair.description: Two functions whose normalized syntax trees are similar enough to be worth review, scored by Jaccard similarity over their subtree fingerprints.

first_file.description: Source file of the side that sorts first.

first_function.description: Its function name. Methods include the impl-type prefix, e.g. `Foo::bar`.

second_file.description: Source file of the side that sorts second.

second_function.description: Its function name. Methods include the impl-type prefix, e.g. `Foo::bar`.

score.description: Jaccard similarity of the two fingerprint sets, in [0, 1].

triage.description: The triage model's advisory verdict on this pair, whichever provider gave it, present only when triage ran. Below the confidence floor `kind` is `uncertain` and only `confidence` accompanies it: no kind, and none of the other answers, is asserted.

kind.description: What kind of duplication the pair is, or `uncertain` below the confidence floor.

worth_extracting.description: Whether the pair should become one function: the level nearest `worth_extracting_score`.

worth_extracting_score.description: The model's probability-weighted position across the four worth-extracting levels.

divergence_risk.description: Probability that a fix to one side would be needed in the other and missed there.

confidence.description: The kind's confidence; below the configured floor the kind is `uncertain`.

file.description: Source file containing the function. Absolute on workspace runs, relative otherwise.

function.description: Function name. Methods include the impl-type prefix, e.g. `Foo::bar`.

cyclomatic.description: McCabe cyclomatic complexity. Always >= 1; fractional when a non-default `try_weight` is in force.

coverage.description: Coverage percentage in [0, 100], or null when no coverage data was found for this file.

crap.description: CRAP = comp(m)^2 * (1 - cov(m)/100)^3 + comp(m). Floor of 1.0.

crate.description: Cargo workspace member name. Present only on `--workspace` runs.

uncovered.description: Maximal runs of instrumented-but-never-hit lines inside the function's span. Omitted when empty or when the file had no coverage data at all.

start.description: 1-indexed first uncovered line of the range (inclusive).

end.description: 1-indexed last uncovered line of the range (inclusive).

ScopeDiagnostics.description: Source/LCOV scope overlap (spec 24). Large stray sets mean the analyzed tree and the coverage run describe different scopes.

analyzed_files.description: Distinct source files that produced at least one analyzed function.

lcov_files.description: Distinct SF records in the LCOV report.

matched_files.description: Files present on both sides after path matching.

source_only.description: Analyzed files with no LCOV match.

lcov_only.description: LCOV SF files matched by no analyzed file.

StrayFiles.description: One side's stray files: the true count plus at most 10 sorted example paths.

count.description: True number of stray files on this side (not capped).
